sections.heading: Every membership includes
paragraphs: Club hours: 5am-8pm, seven days a week. Members have fob access 24/7. (Office hours: Mon-Fri 8am-4pm, Sat by appointment.)
bullets: Access to quality rowing classes and equipment.
Rowing shells, kayaks, and paddle boards for your whole family.

Lake Union waterfront access on our oversized floating dock for picnics, sun bathing, water activities, and club events.
Members Lounge boasting panoramic views of Lake Union and the Seattle skyline, a BBQ deck, a large river rock fireplace, billiards, darts, shuffleboard, TV's and a full bar!
Use of our full gym and cardio room with RP3 and Concept 2 ergs, bicycles, free weights, and more.

College Club Seattle is the proud owner of multiple sets of Seahawks season tickets as well as UW Husky Football season tickets. These are offered to our members annually with limited availability.
